name: SEO Image Blueprint – Insert missing Alt Tags and Compress images for SEO
author: Sadhan Pal

sections.description:
SEO Image Blueprint is a comprehensive WordPress plugin designed to help you optimize your website’s images for better SEO performance and accessibility. The plugin provides an intuitive interface to manage alt tags and compress large images across your entire media library.

Key Features

  • Alt Tag Management: Easily view and edit alt tags for all images in your media library
  • Image Compression: Automatically compress large images (over 2MB) to improve site performance
  • Real-time Updates: Changes to alt tags are automatically applied to all posts using the image
  • Smart Search: Find images by filename, alt tag, or post title
  • Usage Tracking: See which posts use each image with direct links
  • Bulk Operations: Manage multiple images efficiently with pagination
  • Performance Stats: Dashboard showing missing alt tags and compression opportunities

Why Use SEO Image Blueprint?

SEO Benefits:
– Improve search engine rankings with proper alt tags
– Reduce page load times with optimized images
– Better accessibility compliance for screen readers

Performance Benefits:
– Automatic image compression reduces bandwidth usage
– Faster page loading improves user experience
– Optimized images reduce server storage requirements

User Experience:
– Clean, intuitive admin interface
– Real-time search and filtering
– Modal editing for quick alt tag updates
– Visual feedback for compression status

How It Works

  1. Scan: The plugin automatically scans your media library
  2. Analyze: Identifies images missing alt tags and those needing compression
  3. Optimize: Provides tools to add alt tags and compress images
  4. Update: Automatically updates all posts using the modified images

Technical Features

  • Supports JPEG, PNG, and GIF image formats
  • Maintains image quality while reducing file size
  • Creates automatic backups before compression
  • Caches data for improved performance
  • AJAX-powered interface for smooth user experience
  • Responsive design works on all devices

Technical Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • GD or ImageMagick extension for image processing
  • Sufficient server memory for image processing (recommended: 256MB+)
  • Write permissions for wp-content/uploads directory

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit:
* Plugin support forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/seo-image-blueprint/
* Contact: https://bloggingfoundation.com/contact/

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All image processing is performed locally on your server. The plugin only accesses your WordPress media library and post content to provide its functionality.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “SEO Image Blueprint”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload the seo-image-blueprint folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

After Installation

  1. Go to Image SEO in your WordPress admin menu
  2. The plugin will automatically scan your media library
  3. Start optimizing your images by adding alt tags and compressing large files
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all image formats?

The plugin supports JPEG, PNG, and GIF formats for compression. Alt tag management works with all image formats supported by WordPress.

Will compressing images reduce their quality?

The plugin uses intelligent compression that maintains visual quality while reducing file size. It creates backups before compression and only applies compression if it results in meaningful size reduction.

Can I undo image compression?

Yes, the plugin creates automatic backups before compression. If you’re not satisfied with the results, you can restore the original image.

Does the plugin slow down my website?

No, the plugin only runs in the WordPress admin area and uses caching to ensure fast performance. Image compression actually improves your website’s loading speed.

Will alt tag changes affect my existing posts?

Yes, when you update an alt tag, the plugin automatically updates all posts that use that image, ensuring consistency across your website.

Is the plugin compatible with page builders?

Yes, the plugin works with popular page builders like Elementor, Gutenberg, and classic editor. It updates images regardless of how they were added to your posts.

Can I bulk edit alt tags?

Currently, the plugin focuses on individual image editing for accuracy. Each image can be quickly edited through the modal interface with search and filtering capabilities.

Does this work with CDN services?

The plugin works with most CDN services. However, image compression is performed on your server before files are distributed to the CDN.
